A meeting of the Antimicrobial Drugs Advisory Committee was held on October 16, 2019.

recommendation.text: On the voting question (whether the Applicant provided substantial evidence of efficacy and sufficient evidence of safety of cefiderocol for cUTI including pyelonephritis in patients with limited or no alternative treatment options), the committee voted 14 Yes, 2 No, 0 Abstain.

linkages.concern: Committee members were concerned about the mortality imbalance disfavoring cefiderocol in the CREDIBLE-CR trial and about how the drug might be used off-label once approved; some members recommended a boxed warning to communicate the mortality safety concern for off-label use.
linkages.change: The FDA added a new mortality Warning and Precaution in section 5.1 of the labeling (rather than a Boxed Warning) describing the CREDIBLE-CR mortality imbalance.

concern_quote.quote: The committee noted the label should indicate warnings for mortality, with some members recommending a boxed warning to communicate the safety concern for off-label use of cefiderocol for treatment of infections other than cUTI.

change_quote.quote: Communicating to health care providers in labeling regarding the mortality imbalance disfavoring cefiderocol in the CREDIBLE-CR study was discussed by the Advisory Committee and was a significant review issue. While the Agency review team considered a Boxed Warning, it was decided that a Warning and Precaution in section 5.1 in the Prescribing Information was more appropriate for this drug indicated for patients who have limited or no available treatment options.

linkages.concern: The committee recommended that the mechanisms associated with the increase in cefiderocol minimum inhibitory concentrations (MICs)/acquired resistance be identified.
linkages.change: A postmarketing requirement (PMR 3744-6) was imposed to conduct a study to define the mechanism(s) of resistance to cefiderocol for isolates identified as resistant in the surveillance study.

concern_quote.quote: It was recommended that the mechanisms associated with the increase in cefiderocol minimum inhibitory concentrations be identified.

change_quote.quote: **PMR 3744-6:** Conduct a study to define the mechanism(s) of resistance to cefiderocol for isolates identified as being resistant to cefiderocol in the surveillance study (five years from the date of marketing).

summary: The Antimicrobial Drugs Advisory Committee met on October 16, 2019 to discuss NDA 209445 (cefiderocol/FETROJA) and voted 14-2 (0 abstentions) that the Applicant provided substantial evidence of efficacy and sufficient safety for cUTI including pyelonephritis in patients with limited or no alternative treatment options. The committee's central concern was the mortality imbalance disfavoring cefiderocol in the CREDIBLE-CR trial, with some members recommending a boxed warning for off-label use; the review team explicitly weighed this and instead added a Warning and Precaution in section 5.1 of the label. The committee also recommended identifying the mechanisms of increased cefiderocol MICs, which aligns with the resistance-mechanism postmarketing requirement (PMR 3744-6) imposed at approval.
